The '''''Sendant Pride''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military vessel that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Sendant" /> The warship was part of a massive [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that was preparing for an invasion of the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but the fleet was ambushed by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] near the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. The ship survived for several days until the battle reached the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="Gnost" /> when it was among those warships that crashed into the region later known as the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] during the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Sendant" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Sendant Pride'' appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]; the area around the ship is a subregion of the Starship Graveyard entitled "Wreckage of the Sendant Pride." The wreck was originally planned to be involved in "Recovering the Sendant Pride," a mission for Republic players, but the mission and its quest giver, Lieutenant Alden, did not appear in the final game.
